Description: Enables Proton/Wine full debug log output written to ~/steam-438100.log
Notes: Useful for diagnosing Proton/VRChat launch failures. Creates large log files. Source: ProtonPlus

Description: Overrides the directory where Proton log files are written
Notes: e.g. PROTON_LOG_DIR=/tmp — prevents log clutter in home directory

Updates DLSS components for supported games via NVIDIA NGX

Description: Forces OpenGL (WineD3D) fallback instead of DXVK for Direct3D 9-11
Notes: Source: ProtonPlus; use when DXVK causes crashes

Description: Enables D7VK for older Direct3D 7 and 8 era games
Notes: Source: ProtonPlus; requires a compatible Proton version

Notes: Source: ProtonPlus; requires Proton 11-1 or newer

Notes: Source: ProtonPlus; requires Proton-GE/Proton-CachyOS/Proton-EM and compatible AMD GPU

Notes: Source: ProtonPlus; requires FSR 4.0.3+ and compatible AMD hardware

Description: Enables seccomp-based syscall sandboxing for Proton processes
Notes: Disable (set 0) if game crashes immediately on launch

column7: e.g. WINEDEBUG=-all,+openxr — use vrclient for VRChat-specific Wine logs

column8: Separate multiple with semicolons. iyuv_32= fixes video codec issues in VRChat

Description: Overrides the Wine prefix directory path for this game session
Notes: Usually not needed — Steam sets this automatically for Proton games

Enables Vulkan synchronization 2 extension in Wine/Proton Vulkan layer
Enables futex_waitv kernel syscall for synchronization — reduces CPU overhead
Sets PulseAudio latency target in milliseconds
column9: Source: ProtonPlus; lower = less latency but more risk of audio glitches

Description: Sets Wine ALSA output channel count
column8: Source: ProtonPlus; requires Proton 11-1 or newer

Description: Enables Wine ALSA spatial downmix for 4/6/8 channel configurations
Notes: Source: ProtonPlus; requires 4+ output channels via WINEALSA_CHANNELS

Notes: Source: community; needed for WiVRn/Monado/other host OpenXR runtimes

Forces the game to run on the AMD discrete GPU on hybrid graphics systems
Notes: Source: ProtonPlus; set to 1 to use dGPU

Description: Chooses the AMD Vulkan ICD — RADV (Mesa) or AMDVLK (AMD official)
Notes: Source: ProtonPlus; RADV is generally preferred for gaming

Controls Mesa GL threading — improves multi-threaded OpenGL performance

column7: Source: ProtonPlus; AMD ACO compiler only

Notes: Source: ProtonPlus; requires compatible game and CachyOS build
